### Meaning
| infl.      | class      | meaning                       |
| ---------- | ---------- | ----------------------------- |
| ~          | *n.*       | movement, motion              |
| ~en        | *v.*       | to move, walk, travel (intr.) |
| ...thu ~en | *caus. v.* | to move (tr.)                 |
| ~a         | *psv.*     | moved, shifted                |
### Etymology
#### Glyph
similar to **en**, depicting a running man.
#### Sound
- toki pona "tawa"
- *a priori:* t=control, a=energy
